title: slack-notice config
description: ~/.config/slack-notice/config.yaml (XDG respected) plus config.d/*.yaml in lexical order. Invalid config exits 2 (config_invalid), naming the key. Drop-ins: maps merge, other lists replace. Precedence: flags, then environment (scalar keys only), then config, then defaults. Self-contained: no external references.

duration.description: Seconds as a positive number, a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. '1s'), or a bare number string meaning seconds; zero is refused. Ranges are enforced by the loader and named in the key's description.

enabled.description: false makes send exit 22 without reading the credential.

webhook_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the trigger URL. The URL itself is never in config.

body_variable.description: Name of the workflow's text variable.

level_prefix.description: One-line prefixes, at most 16 characters each. Cannot be set from the environment.

max_chars.description: Body limit in Unicode code points.

min_interval.description: Minimum time between sends from this machine, 1s to 60s.

timeout.description: Budget for one send, including waiting for the lock and retries, 1s to 120s.
